scripts.build: (node -e "process.exit(process.env.TURBO_HASH ? 0 : 1)" || pnpm -w all //#gen) && pnpm --dir ../../vendor/eliza --filter @elizaos/cloud --filter @repo/design-system run build && pnpm --dir ../../vendor/eliza --filter @elizaos/cloud-worker run build && vibelang -p tsconfig.json
scripts.bundle: pnpm build && node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('wrangler.jsonc', 'utf8')); for (const [environment, { assets, vars }] of Object.entries(config.env)) { const outDir = path.resolve(assets.directory); if (path.dirname(outDir) !== path.resolve('.wrangler/assets')) throw new Error('Worker assets must be in a directory under .wrangler/assets'); fs.rmSync(outDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('../../vendor/eliza/packages/cloud-worker/dist/pages', outDir, { recursive: true }); const env = { ...process.env, VITE_GRACE_CLOUD_API_ORIGIN: vars.PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN, VITE_GRACE_CLOUD_WEB_ORIGIN: vars.WEB_ORIGIN }; execFileSync('pnpm', ['--filter', '@repo/app', 'build', '--outDir', outDir, '--emptyOutDir=false'], { env, stdio: 'inherit' }); execFileSync('wrangler', ['deploy', '--env', environment, '--dry-run', '--outdir', '.wrangler/bundle/' + environment], { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.deploy: pnpm bundle && pnpm --filter @repo/app test:browser test/browser.browser.test.tsx -t 'Browse and return to the page I left' && wrangler deploy --env production
